req.title: Set cookie via query string
req.statement: The system shall set cookies for every k=v pair supplied in the query string of GET /cookies/set.

doc.reasoning: The endpoint GET /cookies/set sets one cookie per k=v query parameter and redirects to /cookies. Tests must verify: (1) a single k=v pair sets exactly that cookie (EP positive), (2) multiple k=v pairs all get set (DT positive), (3) no query params yields no cookies set (BVA boundary), (4) a single param with empty value is accepted (BVA boundary), (5) the redirect target is exactly /cookies (STC), and (6) the response is a redirect not a 200 directly (NEG). Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes (302 vs 200/301), exact cookie names and values, exact redirect Location header, and exact cookie count.

tests.name: test_set_single_cookie_via_query_string
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
No pre-existing cookies in test client
trace: R-HTTPBIN-031: system shall set cookies for every k=v pair in query string
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_single_cookie_via_query_string():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set?foo=bar', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location == '/cookies'
    set_cookie = r.headers.get('Set-Cookie', '')
    assert 'foo=bar' in set_cookie

test_set_single_cookie_via_query_string()

from httpbin.core import app
import json
client = app.test_client()

def test_set_multiple_cookies_via_query_string():
    r = client.get('/cookies/set?alpha=1&beta=2&gamma=3', follow_redirects=True)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = json.loads(r.data)
    cookies = data['cookies']
    assert cookies.get('alpha') == '1'
    assert cookies.get('beta') == '2'
    assert cookies.get('gamma') == '3'
    assert len(cookies) == 3

test_set_multiple_cookies_via_query_string()
